QuestInfo.name: Black Bark's Worry
QuestInfo.0: The Nautilus' First Officer and handsome muscle man, Black Bark has a worry? I should go talk to him in the conference room of The Nautilus' central corridor.
QuestInfo.1: Black Bark wants to give Kyrin a pretty dress for her birthday, something that expresses everyone's warmest regards toward her. He's apparently asked his old friend and dressmaker, Mrs. Ming Ming, to make the dress, but she's run out of bright white material. She says that a table cloth made of Jr. Wraiths is best for the dress she's making... You need to gather #b15 Table Cloths#k and bring them to #bMrs. Ming Ming#k. \n\n#i4000035##t4000035#  #b#c4000035#/15#k
QuestInfo.2: I've collected the table cloths and have brought them to Mrs. Ming Ming. I wonder what the dress will look like!

0.0: 하하핫~ 거기 자네!! 곧 카이린의 생일이란 걸 알고 있나? 어휴~ 쪼끄만 꼬마 숙녀일때부터 데리고 다닌 녀석이 벌써 이렇게 커버리다니... 감동이야~ 감동!
0.1: 그렇지. 그래서 얼마 전에 선원 투표를 했는데 카이린님의 생일 선물로 가장 좋은 걸로 드레스가 당첨 되었지 머야. 하핫~ 나도 그 녀석을 오래 봐왔지만 여성스러운 드레스를 입은 적을 본 적이 없어. 그래서 드레스 제작을 내 오랜 친구 밍밍부인에게 부탁했네. 그런데... 재료가 없다고! 혹시 자네가 구해다 줄 수 있겠나?

yes.0: 하하하~ 요새 젊은이들 답지 않게 성실하고 착하고 대단한 멋진 선원이군! 역시 노틸러스호 선원이야! 드레스 제작을 위해선 하얗고 얇고 질 좋은 천이 필요한데 그게 주니어 레이스의 식탁보가 제격이라고 하더군. 식탁보 40개만 모아서 밍밍부인에게 가져다 주게.

0.0: Hey there! Are you aware that Kyrin's birthday is coming up! Seriously, to see her all grown up now, that is just astounding. Seriously!
0.1: That's why a few days ago, the crew voted and we decided the best birthday present for her would be a dress. Yes, I've seen her for a long time, and I have honestly never seen her wear a feminine dress. That's why I asked my dear friend Mrs. Ming Ming for help, and the problem is, we don't have the materials! Can you get some for us?

yes.0: Hahaha! Unlike other young people these days, you're a very diligent crewman! Of course, it's because you're a part of the Nautilus! In order to make a dress, a strong, white material is needed. Jr. Wraiths are the best for that. Get #b15 Table Cloths#k and take them to #bMrs. Ming Ming#k.

1.0: I heard it from Black Bark already. Seriously, he asks for favors first, and then thinks about it. Sigh... I am busy preparing for this festival... if he wasn't an old friend of mine, then the answer would have been no...

yes.0: You brought 15 Table Cloths! Now, time to make a dress!

npc.0: Mrs. Ming Ming is at Henesys.

item.0: You didn't get 15 Table Cloths. I cannot make a dress.
